Ka'kari: Elemental artifacts of the Night Angel cosmology; seven colors, one Black
Wetboy: Magical assassin; one who kills with both blade and talent
Talent: Night Angel's term for magical ability
Drafting: Lightbringer's magic: pulling luxin from light by color
Luxin: Physical substance drafted from light; has color-specific properties
Halo: The visible ring on a drafter's iris showing how close to madness/death they are
Prism: The supreme drafter who can draw all seven colors
Prismatic Satrap: Political office held by a drafter of rare capability
Sub-red / Super-violet: Extreme ends of the spectrum; heat and paracosm
Chromeria: The drafting academy; political and religious center
Breaking the halo: Drafting past capacity — leads to madness, black paranoia, death
